Thank you for installing {{ .Chart.Name }}.

Your release is named {{ .Release.Name }}.

The controller and CRDs have been installed in namespace {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

IMPORTANT: each certificate identity references a pre-existing kubernetes.io/tls
Secret (its `certSecretName`) holding the bootstrap cert (tls.crt) and RSA key
(tls.key). This chart references those Secrets but does NOT create them. Create any
that do not yet exist, e.g.:

  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} create secret tls {{ .Values.clusterIdentity.certSecretName | default "cluster-cert-identity" }} \
    --cert=tls.crt --key=tls.key

To verify the installation:

  kubectl get pods -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  kubectl get customresourcedefinitions

To learn more about the release, try:

  $ helm status {{ .Release.Name }} -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
  $ helm get all {{ .Release.Name }} -n {{ .Release.Namespace }}
